title: My page
description: Your Cove account, and how you appear in each academy.
load_failed: Your profile could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

identity.switch_hint: You belong to {{count}} academies. Only the one you choose is shown.
identity.no_academy_body: Your account, preferences, and sign-in settings are below. An academy profile appears here once a membership is active.
identity.unsaved_body: You have edits in {{section}} that are not saved. Switching academy discards them.

image.label: Profile photo
image.crop_help: Use the sliders or arrow keys to position the photo inside the circle.
image.crop_failed: Cove could not prepare this photo. Try a different image.
image.hint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 5 MB. Cove crops it to a square and stores it privately.
image.fallback_note: Removing the academy photo reveals your Cove photo again. It does not delete it.

academy.title: Academy profile
academy.description: How you appear inside {{academy}}. Leave a field empty to use your global value.

student_details.title: Student details
student_details.description: School and contact information the academy needs to look after you. Only you and academy managers can read it.

student_expression.title: What you want to build
student_expression.description: Your own words. Managers can read this and cannot change it.

staff.title: Teaching profile
staff.description: What you teach, and how the academy introduces you.

learning.title: Classes and courses
learning.description: Where you are learning right now.

teaching.title: Classes you teach
teaching.description: The classes you are currently responsible for.

authority.title: What you can do here
authority.description: Your role decides this. It is not changed from this page.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your name and contact details across every academy.

global_photo.title: Cove profile photo
global_photo.description: Your default photo across Cove. Academy photos override it only inside that academy.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How Cove presents itself to you.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.description: Only you can change these. No academy manager can.

field.academy_display_name_help: Empty means your global name is used.
field.contact_phone_help: Cove stores this and does not verify it yet.
field.learning_goal_placeholder: One sentence about what you are working towards.
field.bio_placeholder: A sentence or two students and parents will read.
field.timezone_help: Empty means Cove follows your browser.

conflict.title: This section changed somewhere else
conflict.body: Someone at the academy saved this section while you were editing. Your draft is kept. Load the current values to see theirs, then decide what to keep.

security.password_set: A password is set for this account.
security.password_none: You sign in with a connected account. There is no Cove password to change.
security.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
security.password_same: Choose a new password that is different from your current password.
security.password_weak: That password does not meet the security requirements. Choose a stronger password.
security.password_rate_limited: Too many password attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
security.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.password_sessions_failed: Password changed, but Cove could not sign out other devices. Try again later from Security.
security.password_failed: The password could not be changed. Sign in again and retry.
security.email_sent: Check {{email}} for a confirmation link. Your current address keeps working until you confirm.
security.email_failed: The email change could not be started. Try again.
security.sessions_unavailable: Cove does not yet list sessions. Changing your password signs out other devices.
security.phone_unverified: Cove stores your contact number but does not verify it yet.

learning.classes_empty: You are not enrolled in a class yet.
learning.courses_empty: No courses are open to you yet.
learning.teaching_empty: No classes are assigned to you right now.

authority.TEAM_LEAD: You review and publish curriculum, and you run classes and teacher assignments.
authority.MANAGER: You manage members, memberships, and academy settings.
authority.note: Roles and membership status are changed from member management, never from a profile.

manager.title: Member profile
manager.description: Correct {{name}}'s profile for {{academy}}. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
manager.not_allowed: Only an active manager of this academy can open a member profile.
manager.self_note: This is your own membership. Your account and security settings live on My page.
manager.ownership_note: Sign-in email, password, connected accounts, and the person's global name are theirs alone. This page cannot change them.
manager.expression_read_only: The student wrote this. You can read it and cannot change it.
